The Zhiyun Weebill 2S 3-Axis Handheld Gimbal Stabilizer is a follow-up to the Crane-2 and has been significantly updated to better fit the demands of filmmakers. The CRANE 2S can stabilize big cameras like the Blackmagic Pocket 6K, Panasonic S1H, and Canon EOS 1DX Mark II, as well as accessories, thanks to its innovative 9th Instune Algorithm, which increases the response of each axis. (A complete list of compatible cameras and lenses may be seen on the Zhiyun website. The CRANE 2S has specialized mounting hooks for adding an optional Zhiyun-Tech TransMount transmitter to allow a collaborative approach. Another new feature is a vertical quick-release mount, which allows you to place your camera up vertically to satisfy the increased need for social media material. Aside from that, new FlexMount technology is employed to mount your camera traditionally. This technology streamlines the mounting and setup procedure while also providing double-safety protection for your camera. A two-phase locking design has also been developed on the axis-locking mechanism for balancing a camera. The axis-locking mechanism also guarantees that the gimbal components do not shift during transport or storage. The gimbal's grip handle is composed of carbon fiber, making it seem lighter in your hand. The built-in handwheel on the side of the handle has been updated to enable a very minimal latency when operating an add-on lens motor, which is supplied separately, allowing for more precise adjustments. (If you're utilizing both a focus and a zoom motor, you may use the handwheel to adjust which one you use.) A 1/4"-20 thread on the bottom of the handle allows you to attach the accompanying micro tripod as a stand or an extension that may be held with the other hand for better control. Advanced cinematic capabilities including panorama, time-lapse, motion-lapse and long exposure time-lapse may be done with the gimbal using the associated iOS/Android mobile app to generate unique effects. Many of the gimbal's characteristics may be tweaked through the app, and many critical modes and parameters can be accessed directly from the 0.96" OLED screen above the handle. Servo motors are among the specialized Zhiyun-Tech TransMount accessories that may be used with the CRANE 2S. The gimbal's fast-release plate is compatible with a wide range of tripod heads, allowing you to quickly switch between the gimbal and tripods, sliders, and other camera supports. A lens control and numerous camera control connections are also supplied for a complete workflow. The CRANE 2S is powered by three included batteries that may last up to 12 hours and can be recharged using the included triple charger. It offers no warranty.

products.description:
Zhiyun WEEBILL 3 Handheld Gimbal Stabilizer

The WEEBILL-3 Handheld Gimbal Stabilizer Combo from Zhiyun-Tech has the same improved design as the WEEBILL-3 and includes an extendable sling grip set and backpack to bring the bundle on your next run-and-gun shoot. Forgo bringing additional accessories on shoots, thanks to the gimbal's built-in microphone and fill light. Both the microphone and fill light are integrated into the optimized sling structure of the gimbal and avoid adding heft to its design. View your settings with the 0.96" OLED touchscreen and toggle between modes or parameters with the various buttons. Three built-in 2600mAh batteries power your WEEBILL-3 for up to 21 hours and can even charge your camera with quick charge technology. Dual quick release plates with 1/4"-20 screws prevent the need to constantly rebalance your rig when switching to handheld or changing batteries. Two rosette mounts with 1/4"-20 threads allow you to incorporate the sling grip extension handle and wrist rest, while a 1/4"-20 thread at the bottom of the gimbal supports the included tripod accessory. Control for both the gimbal and camera can be achieved by connecting one of the many control cables and utilizing either the onboard buttons or the smartphone app via the gimbal's Wi-Fi and Bluetooth capabilities. This ZHIYUN WEEBILL 3 Gimbal Stabilizer has no warranty.
